test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0052c437c6c9c9489d5664a9ab5db79bfaa1b4f386cb2dd3058220c8636e2c4d.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The circles are removed, one rectangle and one triangle are added and a new symbol is introduced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f4c6a3c56bc0198c855c51a5dbe154ef116c6293f2f2f3f46a39883b133bd33.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The rectangles are removed, one triangle and one (%) symbol are added and a new symbol is introduced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/400bcd8677d7e769d936751928d3a75cff2387ac14e17acc00e06e60836a3d2d.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The triangles are removed, one (%) symbol and one (+) symbol are added and a new symbol (+) is introduced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d45e7175c5fc213ed67ac030cd0f392067f4d8789b7095faeb20eb7315a68ca4.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure:**

The (%) symbols are removed, one (+) symbol and one (=) symbol are added and a new symbol (*) is introduced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9df75145455bf5036bb39ff5dcf48caa4158652cdacf7c12154d6c763d073789.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (1)".**
